description:
Directly update the full page source JSON.
IMPORTANT: Before calling this tool, you MUST:
1. Read existing source with get_page_source first
2. Show the user what will change and get explicit confirmation
3. NEVER call without user approval — this replaces the ENTIRE page source
Safeguarded: blocks if new source is <50% of existing size.

allow_shrink.description: Allow the source to shrink by more than half: set it when native elements replaced an oversized embed or custom_css and you have read it first.

custom_code.description: Custom code (CSS/JS) for this page. Last resort, same rules as update_site_custom_code.

native_gap.description: Only when the code was refused and no native way exists: the need, the elements/apps you checked, and what each one lacks. Tell the user first.

source.description: Full page source object (sections tree) or JSON string

name: update_page_source
